description: This file defines a Java interface 'AnswerRepository' that extends JpaRepository, providing data access methods for the 'Answer' entity. It includes a custom method to find answers by question ID.

classes.name: AnswerRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing Answer entities, including custom query method for fetching answers by question ID.

methods.name: findByQuestionId
methods.description: Custom query method to retrieve a list of Answer objects associated with a specific question ID.
